title: Closing Method Schedule: Digital Closing Credits on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
Larkspur credits a Mortgage Loan File's initial Closing Disclosure for a digital closing, according to the closing method of the file's closing in scheduled status — the Closing and Funding engagement now scheduled on the file.

| File's closing in scheduled status | Credit added |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | 250.00 USD |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | 150.00 USD |
| any other closing method | nothing |
| no closing in scheduled status on the file | nothing |

**Schedule clause.** Where the file's closing in scheduled status is a Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing, 250.00 USD is added; where it is a Larkspur Hybrid eClosing, 150.00 USD is added; for any other closing method, or where the file has no closing in scheduled status, nothing is added.

Hypothetical illustrations: a file whose scheduled closing is a Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing or a Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing receives no digital closing credit; a file whose scheduled closing is a Larkspur Hybrid eClosing receives 150.00 USD; a file whose only closing engagement was cancelled has no closing in scheduled status and receives nothing.
